formal_name: Repaired-State Sufficiency Falsification, Same-(Q,R,G)/Different-Y Witness Construction, Hidden-Coordinate Necessity Search, Prospective State-Collision Design, Structured-Gate Residualization, Cross-Mechanism Quotient Nonuniqueness, Minimal Sufficiency-Separating Intervention Basis, Observational Equivalence Breaking & the Boundary Between Semantic Repair and Genuine State-Ontology Failure
explanandum: After prospective repair of action necessity versus implementation route, does the repaired observable state Z=(Q,R,G) actually suffice to determine the public action Y on admissible interventional support, or can two genuinely matched repaired states diverge in Y in a way that cannot be explained by measurement aliasing, gate under-resolution, route misclassification, environment mismatch, or a prospectively admissible hidden coordinate?

formal_objects.Omega: admissible mechanism-state space under the frozen public action contract
formal_objects.I: prospectively declared family of admissible non-Y interventions
formal_objects.Z: repaired observable state map Z=(Q,R,G) evaluated directly and independently of Y
formal_objects.Y: public action/effect map measured by one frozen common oracle
formal_objects.deterministic_sufficiency: there exists f such that Y=f∘Z on declared interventional support
formal_objects.collision: two admissible states s1,s2 with Z(s1)=Z(s2) and Y(s1)≠Y(s2)

hard_prohibitions: Never define a hidden coordinate H from Y, failure labels, candidate identity, mechanism identity, or post-outcome inspection.
Never call approximate or unresolved measurements equal merely to manufacture a state collision.
Never call a collision genuine until route, environment, oracle, timing, nondeterminism, and structured-G under-resolution audits are passed.

Never repair a collision by adding a coordinate after seeing the collision unless that coordinate came from a prospectively frozen admissible observable family; post-hoc coordinates may generate hypotheses only.
Never infer LAW-R2 from one collision. A first exact collision falsifies sufficiency only at the frozen grain.
Never treat syntactically different quotient coordinates across mechanisms as substantively nonunique when they induce the same reachable-state partition up to bijection.
Never retroactively alter P27, P28, or P29 coordinate semantics or verdicts.

prospective_rivals.R0_SUFFICIENCY_SURVIVES: Every admissible matched Z-fiber tested is Y-homogeneous.
prospective_rivals.R1_MEASUREMENT_ALIASING: Apparent Z equality disappears under direct or higher-resolution measurement without changing ontology.
prospective_rivals.R2_STRUCTURED_GATE_UNDERRESOLUTION: Scalar/coarse G hides a prospectively measurable component; vector refinement removes the apparent collision.
prospective_rivals.R3_ADMISSIBLE_HIDDEN_COORDINATE: A predeclared outcome-independent coordinate H refines Z so that (Z,H) is Y-sufficient on tested support.
prospective_rivals.R4_GENUINE_REPAIRED_STATE_COLLISION: Exact matched Z persists with different Y after frozen confound and structured-G audits; deterministic sufficiency of the repaired state is falsified at this grain.
prospective_rivals.R5_PERSISTENT_REFINEMENT_FAILURE: Independent prospective collisions persist after one or more predeclared admissible refinements, establishing pressure against the current finite state ontology but not universal impossibility of all finite repairs.

collision_admissibility: exact source revision and byte custody for both arms or mechanisms
same frozen public action contract and oracle
direct Q measurement in both states
direct R measurement in both states, including fallback/selected backend if relevant
direct measurement of every prospectively declared relevant G component
environment and configuration matching at the declared grain
repeatability or explicit stochastic model sufficient to reject transient nondeterminism
candidate classification rule frozen before Y comparison
hidden_coordinate_admissibility: H must be named and operationalized before the candidate Y contrast is inspected
H must be measurable independently of Y
H must not be a disguised mechanism identifier or source hash
H must vary under at least one admissible intervention or across prospectively matched states
H must have an interpretable causal/structural role connected to the public action contract
a successful H rescue is state refinement, not evidence for LAW-R2
structured_gate_rule: If multiple independently relevant gate components exist, G is vector-valued. Scalar compression is admissible only after a prospective proof or experiment shows that the compression preserves all Y-relevant distinctions on the declared support.
cross_mechanism_equivalence_rule: Quotients are compared extensionally by the partitions/fibers they induce on reachable states and their intervention responses, not by coordinate names. Quotients inducing isomorphic reachable partitions are treated as equivalent at this grain.
minimal_intervention_objective: Find the smallest prospectively admissible intervention subset whose response signatures either produce an exact Y-heterogeneous Z-fiber or separate all predeclared rival explanations for an apparent collision.
law_r2_pressure_gate: at least one exact prospectively frozen same-Z/different-Y witness
structured-G residualization failed to remove the collision
no predeclared admissible H explains the collision
independent replication or a second mechanistically distinct prospective witness before any LAW-R2 entry recommendation
even then P30 may output LAW_R2_PRESSURE_ESTABLISHED, not LAW-R2 authority itself
claim_ceiling: P29 route/action separation and repaired quotient validation remain authoritative at their tested grain.
A single exact collision may falsify deterministic sufficiency of the frozen repaired state at that grain only.
No finite experiment proves that no possible finite hidden-state refinement exists.
LAW-R2, macro law, SOLID derivation, manuscript authority, and universal latent-state impossibility remain unauthorized unless a later dedicated authority gate promotes them.
freshness_rule: No P30 fresh candidate outcome may be inspected before constitution, mathematical dossier, prospective checker, and preseal are committed.
